
function to run wilcox test on pre/post BRB and return table of p-values
```{r}
run_wilcox <- function(level, str1, str2){
  microbes <- colnames(level)
  tableOfResults<-data.frame(var=microbes)
  tableOfResults$p_wilcox <- NA
  rownames(tableOfResults) <- microbes

  tempR <- filter(level, grepl(str1, rownames(level)))
  tempT <- filter(level, grepl(str2, rownames(level)))

  for(mic in colnames(level)){
    x <- tempR[, mic]
    y <- tempT[, mic]
    thiscommand <- paste("thiswilcox <- wilcox.test(x, y, paired = TRUE)")
    eval(parse(text = thiscommand))
    tableOfResults[mic, "p_wilcox"] <- thiswilcox$p.value
}
  tableOfResults <- tableOfResults %>% select(p_wilcox)
  return(tableOfResults)
}
```

BRB all levels
```{r warning=FALSE}
spec_dif <- run_wilcox(spec, "rB", "tB")
gen_dif <- run_wilcox(gen, "rB", "tB")
fam_dif <- run_wilcox(fam, "rB", "tB")
ord_dif <- run_wilcox(ord, "rB", "tB")
class_dif <- run_wilcox(class, "rB", "tB")
phyl_dif <- run_wilcox(phyl, "rB", "tB")
king_dif <- run_wilcox(king, "rB", "tB")

#combine and filter to p-value < 0.05
BRBresults <- rbind(king_dif, phyl_dif, class_dif, ord_dif, fam_dif, gen_dif, spec_dif) %>% filter(p_wilcox < 0.05)
```

Placebo all levels
```{r warning=FALSE}
spec_dif <- run_wilcox(spec, "rP", "tP")
gen_dif <- run_wilcox(gen, "rP", "tP")
fam_dif <- run_wilcox(fam, "rP", "tP")
ord_dif <- run_wilcox(ord, "rP", "tP")
class_dif <- run_wilcox(class, "rP", "tP")
phyl_dif <- run_wilcox(phyl, "rP", "tP")
king_dif <- run_wilcox(king, "rP", "tP")

#combine and filter to p-value < 0.05
resultsPlacebo <- rbind(king_dif, phyl_dif, class_dif, ord_dif, fam_dif, gen_dif, spec_dif) %>% filter(p_wilcox < 0.05)
```

add direction to BRB results table
```{r}
BRBresults$direction <- NA

sigMics <- rownames(BRBresults)

allMics <- cbind(king, phyl, class, ord, fam, gen, spec)
  
allMics <- allMics %>%
  mutate(time = rownames(allMics)) %>%
  mutate(time = substr(time, nchar(time)-1, nchar(time)))

# p__Firmicutes
temp <- allMics %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarize(mean(p__Firmicutes))

dif <- as.double(temp[3,2] - temp[1,2])
if(dif > 0){
  BRBresults["p__Firmicutes", "direction"] <- "increase"
}else{
  BRBresults["p__Firmicutes", "direction"] <- "decrease"
}
```

```{r}
sigMics <- rownames(results %>% arrange(p_wilcox) %>% slice(1:6))
```











rename NA
```{r}
taxa <- taxa %>%
  mutate(Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), paste0("g__unclassified"), Genus),
          Family = ifelse(is.na(Family), paste0("f__unclassified-", gsub("g__unclassified-", "", Genus)), Family),
          Order = ifelse(is.na(Order), paste0("o__unclassified-", gsub("f__unclassified-", "", Family)), Order),
          Class = ifelse(is.na(Class), paste0("c__unclassified-", gsub("o__unclassified-", "", Order)), Class),
          Phylum = ifelse(is.na(Phylum), paste0("p__unclassified-", gsub("c__unclassified-", "", Class)),Phylum),
         )
```

prep data fro diversity calculation
```{r}
div <- taxa %>%
  select(id, Genus, RelAbun)

div <- dcast(div, id~Genus)
```

calculate alpha diversity using simpsons index
```{r}
div$alpha <- diversity(div %>% select(-id), index = "simpson")
```

prep for t-test
```{r}
div_results <- div %>%
  select(id, alpha) 

BRB <- taxa %>%
  select(id, Subject.ID, variable)

div_results <- merge(BRB, div_results) %>% unique() %>%
  select(Subject.ID, variable, alpha)

div_results_BRB <- div_results %>%
  filter(variable == "rB" | variable == "tB") 

div_results_plac <- div_results %>%
  filter(variable == "rP" | variable == "tP") 
```



compare avg pre/post BRB
```{r}
# avgBRB <- div_results_BRB %>%
#   group_by(variable) %>%
#   summarise(mean(alpha))
# 
# avgPlac <- div_results_plac %>%
#   group_by(variable) %>%
#   summarise(mean(alpha))

rB <-  div_results %>%
  filter(variable == "rB")
rB <- rB$alpha
tB <- div_results %>%
  filter(variable == "tB")
tB <- tB$alpha
rP <- div_results %>%
  filter(variable == "rP")
rP <- rP$alpha
tP <- div_results %>%
  filter(variable == "tP")
tP <- tP$alpha


Hutcheson_t_test(
  rB,
  tB,
  shannon.base = exp(1),
  alternative = "two.sided",
  difference = 0
)

Hutcheson_t_test(
  rP,
  tP,
  shannon.base = exp(1),
  alternative = "two.sided",
  difference = 0
)
```

```{r}
t.test(rB, tB)
t.test(rP, tP)
```


```{r}
check <- taxa %>%
  select(Subject.Number, variable, Genus, RelAbun) %>%
  filter(Genus != "g__unclassified") %>% distinct()

checkRB <- check %>% filter(variable == "rB")
checkTB <- check %>% filter(variable == "tB")

checkRP <- check %>% filter(variable == "rP")
checkTP <- check %>% filter(variable == "tP")


checkBRB <- check %>%
  filter(variable == "rB" | variable == "tB")

checkPlac <- check %>%
  filter(variable == "rP" | variable == "tP")
```

```{r}
BRBmics <- checkBRB %>% select(Genus) %>% distinct()
Placmics <- checkPlac %>% select(Genus) %>% distinct()

BRBmics <- BRBmics$Genus
Placmics <- Placmics$Genus
```

BRB
```{r}
for (mic in BRBmics) {
  temp <- checkBRB %>%
    filter(Genus == mic)
  tempR <- temp %>% filter(variable == "rB")
  tempT <- temp %>% filter(variable == "tB")
  
  if((nrow(tempR) > 1) & (nrow(tempT) > 1)){
    print(mic)
    print(t.test(tempR$RelAbun, tempT$RelAbun))
  }
}
```
